entities.name: Ethan
entities.description: A leader who values empathy over raw power, framed by an agency for his perceived weakness to facilitate their experiments.
entities.quote: Ethan isn’t the unstoppable prodigy — he’s a leader who people don’t understand. He doesn’t win by might; he holds everyone together through empathy, vision, and heart.

entities.name: Nyxia
entities.description: A member of the Sentinels who supported Ethan during his public trial and faced persecution for her loyalty.
entities.quote: And when Nyxia defends him, and they target her too, Ethan’s rage finally breaks his restraint.

entities.name: Elizah
entities.role: Manifestation of Ethan's suppressed dark lineage
entities.description: The dangerous, dark personality emerging from Ethan's bloodline, representing pride and rage.
entities.quote: Elizah appears fully and we see a black- dark red crack into the whole white cell and camera doesn't show who he was. only shows the guards are brutally kiled and down to the floor.

entities.name: Zaan
entities.description: A bloodline ancestor who used blood techniques for life-based, scientific, and spiritual purposes.
entities.quote: Zaan’s art was still blood-based, but his use of it was scientific and spiritual—he treated blood as the essence of life and transformation, not a demonic weapon.

entities.name: Khalid
entities.description: An ancestor whose bloodline art was corrupted toward domination and destruction.
entities.quote: Khalid corrupted the same root art, bending it toward domination and destruction.

entities.name: Sentinels
entities.description: A group of heroes who are controlled by an agency and were disbanded following Ethan's supposed death.
entities.quote: The public believes Ethan is dead. The Sentinels disband. The agency has crossed a moral line.

entities.name: The Agency
entities.description: A group seeking to create super-soldiers by experimenting on Sentinel blood, utilizing propaganda to control the public.
entities.quote: As agency was after the sentinels blood to experiment with their genes and make more super soldier ,they never believed these heroes

timeline_events.title: Public Trial of Ethan
timeline_events.description: Ethan is seized and brought before a jury due to public demand fueled by the agency's propaganda.
timeline_events.quote: he was seized and was tied up to the jury.higher authority jury.where we see him being tired of explaining himself and his honest motive.

timeline_events.title: Imprisonment of Ethan
timeline_events.description: After being beaten and reported dead to the world, Ethan is held in a white cell for experimentation.
timeline_events.quote: he was beaten to death .everywhere its published that he is dead.but in the last part of season 1 we see ethan is still alive but in a white room.trapped or being kept but the agency.

timeline_events.title: Awakening of Elizah
timeline_events.description: Elizah fully manifests within the white cell, killing the guards and breaking out.
timeline_events.quote: Elizah appears fully and we see a black- dark red crack into the whole white cell and camera doesn't show who he was. only shows the guards are brutally kiled and down to the floor.
